component.name: NoteLiner
component.summary: Outliner-style Markdown notes with git sync

description.p: NoteLiner organizes Markdown notes in a tree. Every change is saved and committed to a git repository, and synced to a remote when you set one.

ul.li: A Markdown editor with highlighting, list editing, find and spell check
Wikilinks, backlinks, tags, search and per-note history
Attachments, templates, DOCX/PPTX import and PDF/HTML export
Slides from notes, with a full-screen presenter
An MCP server so AI clients can read and edit notes, with confirmation
